message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through my closet looking for my old go-bag. You know, the one I swore I'd keep ready just in case? Well, I unearthed a collection of mismatched socks, a couple of out-of-date snacks, and a very confused cat who clearly had no idea why I was digging through her domain. 

It made me chuckle at the thought of my grand plans for being prepared, yet here I was, more focused on finding the perfect pair of socks than the essentials. 

It’s a funny reminder that sometimes our best intentions can get buried under the everyday chaos. Perhaps it’s time for a little spring cleaning—not just in the closet, but in our readiness, too. How do you keep your plans organized?
